title: Soča at Log Čezsoški, 2 September 1984, 36 cm
medium: Oil on gessoed birch ply: body colour, glazes laid as films, a scumble for the sky

stages.name: the river turned off, in the light there is: no sun, so no shadows
the rock: steep at the head, going down in ledges toward the bridge
the river back in: four films, the water over the rock's back
fifteen films, and stand oil: the river as it is under the bridge
the sky goes on, everywhere the bridge and I are not in its way
the cloud with the light still on it, bent by the swell
